admission.justification: Two registered cases pin the open item, its closure by an authored row and the untouched second link. An automatic re-point or closure would take the developer's question out of the one seat that asked it, which is the behaviour D430 preserves.

applicability: Every fired reconsider_on link of a decision, in any leaf whose change made its target move.
conditions: A re-point's target comes only from a hand-off row a curator wrote.
A fired link reaches the Curator's worklist as a reconsideration_candidate item and blocks closeout until a row answers it.
raise is admitted wherever it is today.
exclusions: The writer's own refresh of a fired link that still maps to C, which is no judgment about the condition.
A successor decision, which carries its own links.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_reconsideration_recovery.py::test_the_d430_sequence_opens_the_item_and_a_curator_row_closes_it and mcp/tests/test_reconsideration_repoint.py::test_only_the_named_link_is_repointed_and_the_other_fires_as_today, passed 2026-10-21; the unchanged gate and worklist suites also pass

statement: Nothing re-points a link, answers a reconsideration item or writes a rejection on its own: a re-point exists only because a curator wrote one in a hand-off row, and a fired link with no row still reaches the worklist and blocks closeout.
